This page lists the tools that the workshop uses.

## Quarto

Download Quarto from the [Quarto website](https://quarto.org/docs/get-started/).
Run the installer and follow its steps.
Then open a new terminal and run the version command again.

```{.bash .terminal}
$ quarto --version
```

## A text editor

Use any text editor that you like.
Choose an editor that shows a preview next to the page, because it saves time.

::: {.callout-tip}

## Tip

Close the terminal and open it again after the installation.
The new terminal finds the new command.

:::
